verdict.rationale: GitBook documents a dedicated 'Add an OpenAPI specification' feature and API playgrounds, and its Git-sync/version-control capabilities could propagate spec file changes, but the evidence pack gives only page titles with no detail on automatic re-generation or sync-on-change behavior, and no hands-on confirmation that pages actually update when the spec changes. Missing for 10: concrete documentation or user report describing automatic detection/regeneration of reference pages after spec updates, and independent verification of this sync behavior.
